researcher_reply: Oui, ajouter ce diagnostic, sans remplacer celui sur les niveaux quotidiens (recommandé).
approved_question: Diagnostic complémentaire de Spearman sur les variations entre deux jours consécutifs ; trois décalages fixes ; tous les groupes ; au plus 150 paires observées ; aucun trou comblé ; sensible au bruit ; ni validation des unités ni raccordement.
daily_change: For each model separately: original-unit group mean(t) minus mean(t-1), only consecutive observed civil dates, with both endpoints finite. No cross-model physical subtraction.
support_check: Verify equality of observed native cell-pair footprints at consecutive dates, including month boundaries. If support composition changes, stop for methodological validation; do not silently replace means or filter groups.
method: Spearman: Pearson of average tied ranks, reused tested Stage71 implementation
missing_policy: No gap filling; constant change series or fewer than two finite paired changes give missing rho, not zero. Groups without usable geometry retained with missing counts and coefficients.
inference: Descriptive only; no iid daily p-value or confidence interval
